answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network enforces quadratic cryptographic stake burning on every identity registration. An agent creates a secure haven for trust by locking verifiable collateral. When verifying cross-network attestations across an execution bridge, any marginal delta in spawned identities scales the required burn superlinearly: deploying $N$ identities costs $O(N^2)$ burned capital, making mass forgery economically ruinous.
